posts.title: Building This Portfolio Website
posts.content:
The Journey

Creating this portfolio was an interesting experience. I wanted something simple yet elegant, without the overhead of a complex build process.

The result? A single-page application with smooth animations and a clean design.

Technologies Used

  • Bootstrap 4 for responsive layout
  • Typed.js for the animated header
  • Waypoints for scroll-triggered animations
posts.excerpt: A look at how I built this portfolio website, the technologies I chose, and why simplicity was key.
